p.fact: A page address ends with a slash and the projections lie beside it as files: `…/<document>/`, `…/<document>.md`, `…/<document>.xml`.

section.title: The language segment
section.p: The language is the segment after `/doc/`, and the source language carries no segment at all. A translation is served under the source package's coordinate, which is what lets one address become another by changing one segment.
